beats.title: Photovoltaic conversion
beats.audienceText: Photovoltaic cells convert sunlight to electricity.

sources.summary: Photovoltaic cells turn sunlight into electricity. Connected cells form panels, and panels form arrays. PV output is direct current; inverters convert it to alternating current. Batteries charged by PV can supply electricity after sunshine ends.

beats.title: Water storage
beats.audienceText: Water is stored in the atmosphere, on the surface and underground.

sources.summary: The water cycle describes water storage and movement. Water is stored in the atmosphere, at the surface and underground. Condensation and precipitation move water between stores. Human activity affects storage, movement and water quality.
